walk.en: I drift along the magnetic lines, slowly.

walk.zh: 三个迷你鼻子在前面探路。
walk.en: Three mini-noses scout the way ahead.
I am heavy, and I walk steadily.
Stony ground suits my feet exactly.

walk.zh: 我停一下，重新对准北方。
walk.en: I stop to realign with the north.
The compass inside me turns gently.

walk.zh: 我一动，铁屑就被吸过来。
walk.en: As I move, iron filings cling to me.
I skirt the iron vein; it is too loud.

walk.zh: 帽子上的十字一摇一晃。
walk.en: The cross on my hat sways as I go.

walk.zh: 我低头走，磁力探着地面。
walk.en: Head low, I feel the ground with my field.
My steps are slow, but never off course.

walk.zh: 我停在石堆前，等磁力回话。
walk.en: I halt at the stones, waiting for an answer.

idle.zh: 我悬着迷你鼻子，不落地。
idle.en: I keep my mini-noses hovering, off the ground.

idle.zh: 磁极偏了一点点，我调整。
idle.en: The pole has drifted a touch, so I correct it.
Something in the stone is humming.
I stand still as a boundary stone.

idle.zh: 三个鼻子各自看向一边。
idle.en: Each of my three noses watches a different side.
North is that way; I am never wrong.

idle.zh: 铁屑在我脚边排成一圈。
idle.en: Iron dust arranges itself in a ring at my feet.
I make the noses turn half a circle.

idle.zh: 灰尘落在我头上，我不擦。
idle.en: Dust settles on my head and I leave it.
The magnetic field here is very clean.

idle.zh: 我在算脚下岩层的厚度。
idle.en: I am gauging the rock beneath my feet.

idle.zh: 鼻子碰到石头，又缩回来。
idle.en: A nose taps a stone and pulls back.
I have stood motionless for a long while.

idle.zh: 附近有铁矿，我感觉到了。
idle.en: There is iron nearby; I can feel it.

look_player.en: You are carrying iron, are you not.
All my noses have turned toward you.
Do not touch my noses; they will drift.
The field is messy where you stand.
I am measuring the metal on you.
You are blocking north; move aside.
I raise my head to look at you, slowly.

look_player.zh: 你手里的剑，我感觉得到。
look_player.en: I can feel the blade in your hand.
I do not chase; I only point the way.

look_player.zh: 你的指南针坏了，我的没坏。
look_player.en: Your compass is broken; mine is not.

look_player.zh: 我看你，像在看一块矿石。
look_player.en: I look at you the way I look at ore.
Do not hold iron tools so close.
You carry metal in three places.

look_player.zh: 我眯起眼，鼻子微微一颤。
look_player.en: I narrow my eyes and a nose twitches.

tempted.en: That lodestone, let me have a look.
The taste of iron is hard for me to refuse.

tempted.zh: 你举着铁块，我就跟过来。
tempted.en: Hold up iron and I will follow.
The pull is so strong I feel dizzy.

tempted.zh: 别拿走，让我再靠近一点。
tempted.en: Do not take it away; let me come closer.

tempted.zh: 我的鼻子自己飘过去了。
tempted.en: My noses are drifting over on their own.
This ore is of decent quality.
The thing in your hand is pulling at me.
Just once; I will only touch it once.

collide.en: You hit me and cannot move me.
You knocked one of my noses crooked.
I am too heavy to push.
The iron on you scraped against me.
Step back; I am calibrating my bearing.
Stone meets stone with a dull sound.
I am not in the habit of giving way.
I shifted half an inch; that is generous.

mate.zh: 两块磁石，正好吸在一起。
mate.en: Two magnets, made to pull together.

mate.zh: 你的方向，和我的对上了。
我把三个鼻子都朝向你。
mate.en: I turn all three noses toward you.

mate.zh: 别乱动，让我记住这个方位。
mate.en: Hold still and let me memorize this bearing.

mate.zh: 我们不用说话，磁场会说。
mate.en: We need no words; the field speaks.
Come closer; it is warmer on my side.

mate.zh: 我这一生只指一个方向。
mate.en: My whole life points one way.
Even stone learns a face; believe it.
Two needles pointing north are enough.
I saved the brightest ore for you.

pickup.en: This stone holds a fair amount of iron.
I lift it with my noses.
Too heavy, so I set it back down.
A lodestone; not bad luck at all.
I press the ore against my chest.
This pebble points the right way.

pickup.zh: 铁屑全吸在我的石面上。
pickup.en: Iron dust clings all over my stone face.
Holding it, I turn a slow circle.
I tuck it into a crack for safekeeping.

target_acquire.en: You carry iron, so I have you fixed.
All three noses point at you at once.
Bearing confirmed; no need to wait.
I turn slowly until I face you.
I am the keeper of this ground.
You have crossed the line already.
The field tightens; you cannot slip out.
I do not like being struck.
The rock under me belongs to me.

targeting.en: I grip the iron in your boots.
Every step you take, I know it.
The gap closes and the pull grows.
Three noses close on you from three sides.
I am calculating the angle of impact.
You should not stand on an iron vein.

targeting.zh: 我的十字对准了你的胸口。
targeting.en: My cross is aimed at your chest.
The field tightens and you slow down.
You retreat, and I inch forward.

melee_attack.zh: 我一头撞过去，地面一震。
melee_attack.en: I ram headfirst and the ground shakes.
One nose slams into your shoulder.
The pull drags you toward me.
A stone fist is not light.
I lean my whole weight into you.
This blow comes with a spray of filings.
The impact shoves you back a distance.
After the hit, I do not move at all.

spawn.en: I rise out of the rubble.
I find north first, then open my eyes.
I shake off half the dirt.

spawn.zh: 石头落回地面，声音很沉。
spawn.en: The stones settle back with a low sound.
I have stood here many years.
Who was it that woke me.
I turn once to learn the directions.
I know the rock beneath my feet.
Where there is iron, I wake.
The dust settles before I speak.

generic.en: When stone aches, it aches the longest.
The blow knocked my noses off true.
I rock, but I do not fall.
The ache is slow, so I wait for it.
A crack runs through my cross.
Stop hitting; I am repairing my pole.
Keep striking and even stone will break.

fire.en: It cannot burn through, but it is hot.

fall.en: I land and leave a crater.

drown.en: I sink, and my field goes wild.

explosion.en: The blast knocked me off my bearing.

projectile.en: An arrowhead is stuck in a seam.

lightning.en: The lightning leaves me numb all over.

void.en: No north here, and no ground either.
